description: This file contains functions to convert Anthropic AI message content into Gemini format, handling various content blocks such as text, images, tool use, and thought signatures. It also includes message conversion utilities.

methods.name: isThoughtSignatureContentBlock
methods.description: Type guard to check if a content block is a ThoughtSignatureContentBlock.

methods.name: convertAnthropicContentToGemini
methods.description: Converts Anthropic content blocks into Gemini parts, handling signatures, images, tool calls, and skipping unsupported blocks.

methods.name: convertAnthropicMessageToGemini
methods.description: Converts an Anthropic message into Gemini message format, wrapping the content parts with role information.
